prompt: validate.URL rejects valid absolute URLs whose fragment directly follows the host with no path, for example 'http://example.org#fragment' or 'http://user@example.com#fragment'. RFC 3986 allows a fragment after an empty path, and links to a site root with an anchor are common. 'http://example.org/#fragment' is accepted today, so the behaviour is inconsistent. In relative mode a bare '#frag' is also rejected even though a bare '?query' is accepted. Expected: these values validate successfully, and values that were invalid before for other reasons are still rejected.
